title: Miss Tic Escape Rooms
specs: Immersive themed rooms with realistic puzzles and no jump scares
Players under 14 must be accompanied by at least one paying adult; if more than four players under 14, two paying adults required
Comfortable clothing advised; bring reading glasses if needed
Rooms require communication, focus, and critical thinking
Wheelchair accessible: Montauk and Ghost Light; The Bird is not wheelchair accessible
Montauk and Ghost Light max 8 players; The Bird max 5 players; extra players $38 each payable onsite
includes: Game Master guidance and immersive clue system
Use of room and all puzzle elements
gap: Exact price tiers for different group sizes not fully detailed
blurb: Guests participate in live-action escape rooms where they solve interconnected puzzles and challenges within 60 minutes to complete a mission. Rooms include physical locks, buttons, keys, riddles, and mechanical puzzles. The experience is immersive and family-friendly, with some rooms wheelchair accessible.
extraNote: Reschedule free up to 24 hours before game; after 24h rescheduling costs $50 · Cancellations within 4 hours or no-shows are non-refundable and non-transferable · No refunds offered; vouchers issued for absent group members' tickets
